panels.description: Number of distinct peers whose votes were added to an aggregator in the last ~10s, by vote type (supra_moonshot_recent_voters_current). In a healthy N-validator network the prepare series sit near N; a persistent drop of one means a peer has stopped voting. Shows the max across the selected instances, so a network-wide outage is visible with the filter on All; narrow $instance to one node to detect a partition that only affects that node.

panels.description: Sync requests received from peers, split by the kind of payload requested. Counted before authorization and rate-limiting, so this is offered rather than served load. Block requests are served by the consensus helper, batch requests by the mempool helper.

panels.description: Fraction of votes handled by the certifier that were invalid (failed) or duplicate. Rising values indicate Byzantine senders or network duplication.

panels.description: Synchronization request errors as a fraction of all outgoing sync requests (mempool + moonshot initial/retry + finalized block).
